description: Get detailed room information, prices, and images for a specific hotel. Provides comprehensive hotel details including room types, pricing, images, the hotel's facilities and notices (closing periods, units temporarily closed). availability is 'no_rooms' when the hotel exists but has no room for the dates. Use after hotel_search when the user asks about one hotel's rooms, prices or photos. Takes the hotel's id from hotel_search as hotel_id, with the same dates (DD.MM.YYYY). Pass the same adults (total of all rooms), children and rooms as the search. Each offer's free_cancellation_until and cancellation_rules give the cancellation deadline and fees. facilities lists the hotel's facilities and notices its closing periods or closed units: mention a notice that affects the stay. availability no_rooms means no room for these dates. The user books through that hotel's detail_link.

adults.description: Total number of adults in all rooms (default: 2); for 2 rooms with 2 adults each, adults=4, rooms=2

children.description: Ages of children as list (e.g., [8, 12] for 8 and 12 year olds)

limit.description: Number of results per page (max 30, default: 30)

rooms.description: Number of rooms needed (default: 1); the guests are split evenly over the rooms

name: hotel_room_detail
title: Hotel rooms and prices
